protocol.common_inputs: Same immutable FP64 X,b separately reported
protocol.order: Cyclic method order across four cases
protocol.scope: Native development pilot; original small/real cases remain required
protocol.controls: Fixed tolerances omit adaptive diagnostic low-product; all final accuracy is original FP64

audits.scope: Separate setup+steady inner action+reconstruction+Az+optional Mz+literal A residual; no full solve timing.
